items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: My playa dad just one night, and Harold Normandale, that was the Bad Bar in the Orleans at the time.

ctx.x: I don't know, I can't pronounce it.

Yeah, let's see. My playa dad just one night, and Harold Normandale, that was the Bad Bar in the Orleans at the time. Uh huh. He was in all kinds of trouble and all that. He came up with a sawed off shotgun. Yeah. And he started shooting up the joint. I jumped behind the pan, I quit that job.
I heard about, they had a place up there that was so tough, they put the band behind Chicken Wire. Yeah, oh that was, it was in the Audubon Park I believe.
